reason: A read-only local audit utility that checks credential-file permissions, detects embedded Git remote credentials, and counts selected provider token prefixes with bounded scanning and masked output.

summaries.zh: 一个只读的本地凭据卫生审计插件，用于检查凭据文件权限、识别 Git 远程地址中的嵌入式凭据，并统计常见令牌前缀。
summaries.en: A read-only local credential-hygiene audit plugin that checks credential-file permissions, detects embedded Git remote credentials, and counts common token prefixes.

capabilities: Reads local credential-related files and file permissions
Recursively scans bounded Git configuration files
Detects credential-like URL contents and token prefixes
Masks suspected credential values in reported output
